title: Garden Friendship Treasure
moral: Friendship grows when shared with kindness.

scenes.summary: Four friends find a map and begin a treasure hunt in the garden.
scenes.text: Mia, Lola, Nora, and Zoe find a treasure map in the garden and decide to follow it together with excitement.
scenes.image_prompt: four little girls in a colorful garden holding a treasure map smiling cartoon style

scenes.summary: They face small challenges while solving clues.
scenes.text: The girls must solve clues by clapping, pressing a button, and listening carefully to find the next steps.
scenes.image_prompt: children solving treasure clues near slide and tree cartoon style

scenes.summary: They follow clues through the garden locations.
scenes.text: They move from the slide to the apple tree and then to the fountain, helping each other along the way.
scenes.image_prompt: kids walking through garden following clues teamwork cartoon style

scenes.summary: They unlock the treasure box using teamwork.
scenes.text: By showing bravery, kindness, and teamwork, they unlock the wooden box together.
scenes.image_prompt: kids opening treasure box together glowing bracelets cartoon style

scenes.summary: They realize friendship is the real treasure.
scenes.text: They wear friendship bracelets and promise to always help and stay together.
scenes.image_prompt: children wearing friendship bracelets holding hands happy garden cartoon style

story: Mia, Lola, Nora, and Zoe find a treasure map in the garden and decide to follow it together with excitement. The girls must solve clues by clapping, pressing a button, and listening carefully to find the next steps. They move from the slide to the apple tree and then to the fountain, helping each other along the way. By showing bravery, kindness, and teamwork, they unlock the wooden box together. They wear friendship bracelets and promise to always help and stay together.
